posts.name: JJ Pearson
posts.cooked:
Hey all! Long time lurker/player here, first time poster.

 

With Ambuscade's new advanced challenge mode, (and all of the new challenges are awesome!) I've played him a couple times while actually being challenged (how ironic). Hence, I believe I found a loophole which I don't think has been posted here. If he is cloaked, and you destroy the cloaking device and it is replayed before he his turn (via vanish and an out-of-turn play), will he re-flip and become uncloaked as long as the cloaking device is in play?

Danké!
